title: The fall roster
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The college's fall roster comes in the mail. FINCH, A. — AUDITING, typed, without his asking. The instructor put him on. He pins it beside the PNCA letter. Two schools on the corkboard; one of them wants him for nothing.

panels.composition: An envelope from the college, opened. A roster page: names as blocks, and one line: FINCH, A. — AUDITING.

image.prompt: close on a typed college roster with one line at the bottom set apart from the block of names, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD reading it at the desk. BARNABY. He didn't ask to be on it.

image.prompt: a young man reading a typed page at his desk with a small dog beneath, surprised, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The roster pinned beside the PNCA letter. Two schools. Wood looking at both.

image.prompt: a young man pinning a typed page to a corkboard beside an official letter and looking at both, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The corkboard: the letter that offers money; the roster that offers nothing; the bus schedule under both. Wood's finger on the roster. That one.

image.prompt: close on a corkboard with an official letter, a typed roster and a folded bus schedule, a finger resting on the roster, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Two schools on the board. His finger on the one that offers nothing.
